name: Joining (ʿaṭf)
definition: A follower joined to the word before it by a particle of joining, taking its iʿrāb: rafʿ after rafʿ, naṣb after naṣb, jarr after jarr, jazm after jazm.
body: The ten particles of al-Ājurrūmiyya: wa, fa, thumma, aw, am, immā, bal, lā, lākin, and ḥattā in some places. Each joins with a meaning of its own (wa together, fa in sequence at once, thumma after a while, aw one or the other).
Qāma zaydun wa-ʿamrun: ʿamrun is in rafʿ because zaydun is; in raʾaytu zaydan wa-ʿamran both are in naṣb.

examples.text: I passed by Zayd and ʿAmr (al-Ājurrūmiyya).
